title: AI Tattoo Generator
summary: Free AI tattoo generator: describe your idea and get a tattoo design in traditional, fine line, Japanese, blackwork or watercolour style for your artist.
body_markdown:
### Can AI design a tattoo?


Yes. An AI image model can draw a tattoo design from a written description of the motifs, the tattoo style and the linework, which makes it a fast way to explore ideas before a tattoo artist redraws the final version for your skin.


### Is there a free AI tattoo generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and both GPT Image 2.6, which made the designs on this page, and the Auto video model run on it.


### What tattoo styles can AI make?


AI can make most tattoo styles when you name them: American traditional, neo traditional, fine line, Japanese irezumi, blackwork and dotwork, black and grey realism, watercolour, tribal and minimalist line tattoos.


### Can I take an AI tattoo design to a tattoo artist?


Yes, and you should. Bring the design as a reference; a good tattoo artist will redraw it, adjust line weights and size it to your body so it heals well and ages cleanly.


### How do I see what a tattoo will look like on my body?


Describe the design healed on a specific body part with real skin texture and natural light, such as a fine line rose on the inner forearm, or upload a photo of your own arm in Flick and ask an image edit model to place the design on it.


### Can I turn a tattoo design into a video?


Yes. Generate the still first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe slow, simple motion, such as a needle lining the stencil or a camera drifting along the arm.
